_notes.enabled: Master switch. Set by ./install.sh --with-recording, or /recording on
_notes.paused: Temporary stop without losing the setting — /recording pause
_notes.output_dir: Where transcripts are written, relative to the project root
_notes.redact: Extra regexes replaced with [redacted] on top of the built-ins
_notes.digest_lines: Lines of the previous session replayed at SessionStart
_notes.min_interval_seconds: Minimum seconds between two mid-turn renders. Stop and SessionEnd always write, unthrottled.
